newsitem.title: MEXICO: At least 25 injured in Mexico prison riot.
newsitem.headline: At least 25 injured in Mexico prison riot.

text.p: At least 25 people were injured on Saturday when hundreds of inmates rioted at a jail on the edges of Mexico City, breaking windows and burning mattresses before police restored order, officials said on Sunday.

They said about 50 inmates at the Barrientos jail in the suburb of Tlalnepantla, their faces covered by ski masks, seized two guards as hostages during a family visting hour on Saturday and began smashing up the jail. Other prisoners then joined in and made an unsuccessful attempt to escape.
Police called for reinforcements and then launched an attack on the mutineers, firing tear gas into the prison and clubbing the prisoners. Gunshots were heard during the fighting.
Five of the wounded were police and the remainder prisoners, a police spokesman said.
The prisoners were reported to have rioted to demand better living conditions and protest alleged torture and corruption by warders.
